schema.text: What keeps you from getting around on foot, or from doing so more often? (Select all that apply)
schema.help: We ask this to understand what limits walking for different people. Answering is optional, and you can also choose not to say.

options.text: I don't need to: other ways of getting around suit me better
Steep slopes or stairs on the way
Sidewalks missing, too narrow or blocked
Poor lighting or not feeling safe from other people
My health, a disability or my age makes walking difficult
I carry heavy things or accompany children or other people

it.#What keeps you from getting around on f: Che cosa ti impedisce di spostarti a piedi, o di farlo più spesso? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#We ask this to understand what limits w: Lo chiediamo per capire che cosa limita gli spostamenti a piedi per persone diverse. Rispondere è facoltativo e puoi anche scegliere di non dirlo.
it.#Steep slopes or stairs on the way: Salite ripide o scale lungo il percorso
it.#Sidewalks missing, too narrow or blocke: Marciapiedi assenti, troppo stretti o ingombri
it.#Poor lighting or not feeling safe from: Scarsa illuminazione o non sentirmi al sicuro rispetto ad altre persone
it.#My health, a disability or my age makes: La mia salute, una disabilità o l'età rendono difficile spostarmi a piedi
it.#I carry heavy things or accompany child: Porto oggetti pesanti o accompagno bambini o altre persone
it.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Non mi serve: altri modi di spostarmi sono più adatti a me

fr.#What keeps you from getting around on f: Qu'est-ce qui vous empêche de vous déplacer à pied, ou de le faire plus souvent ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#We ask this to understand what limits w: Nous posons cette question pour comprendre ce qui limite la marche selon les personnes. Répondre est facultatif, et vous pouvez aussi choisir de ne pas le dire.
fr.#Steep slopes or stairs on the way: Des pentes raides ou des escaliers sur le trajet
fr.#Sidewalks missing, too narrow or blocke: Des trottoirs absents, trop étroits ou encombrés
fr.#Dangerous crossings or fast traffic: Des traversées dangereuses ou une circulation rapide
fr.#Poor lighting or not feeling safe from: Un mauvais éclairage ou le sentiment de ne pas être en sécurité vis-à-vis d'autres personnes
fr.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Ma santé, un handicap ou mon âge rendent la marche difficile
fr.#Heat or bad weather: La chaleur ou le mauvais temps
fr.#I carry heavy things or accompany child: Je porte des choses lourdes ou j'accompagne des enfants ou d'autres personnes
fr.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Je n'en ai pas besoin : d'autres moyens de déplacement me conviennent mieux

de.#What keeps you from getting around on f: Was hält Sie davon ab, zu Fuß unterwegs zu sein oder es häufiger zu tun? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#We ask this to understand what limits w: Wir fragen dies, um zu verstehen, was das Zufußgehen für verschiedene Menschen einschränkt. Die Antwort ist freiwillig, und Sie können auch angeben, dass Sie es lieber nicht sagen möchten.
de.#Destinations are too far away: Die Ziele sind zu weit entfernt
de.#Steep slopes or stairs on the way: Steile Anstiege oder Treppen auf dem Weg
de.#Sidewalks missing, too narrow or blocke: Gehwege fehlen, sind zu schmal oder versperrt
de.#Poor lighting or not feeling safe from: Schlechte Beleuchtung oder das Gefühl, vor anderen Menschen nicht sicher zu sein
de.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Meine Gesundheit, eine Behinderung oder mein Alter erschweren das Gehen
de.#I carry heavy things or accompany child: Ich trage schwere Dinge oder begleite Kinder oder andere Personen
de.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Ich brauche es nicht: Andere Fortbewegungsarten passen besser zu mir

tr.#What keeps you from getting around on f: Yaya olarak yolculuk etmenizi ya da bunu daha sık yapmanızı engelleyen nedir? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#We ask this to understand what limits w: Bunu, farklı kişiler için yürümeyi neyin sınırladığını anlamak için soruyoruz. Yanıt vermek isteğe bağlıdır; belirtmemeyi de seçebilirsiniz.
tr.#Steep slopes or stairs on the way: Yol üzerinde dik yokuşlar veya merdivenler
tr.#Sidewalks missing, too narrow or blocke: Kaldırımların olmaması, çok dar olması veya kapalı olması
tr.#Dangerous crossings or fast traffic: Tehlikeli yaya geçitleri veya hızlı trafik
tr.#Poor lighting or not feeling safe from: Yetersiz aydınlatma veya diğer insanlara karşı kendimi güvende hissetmemem
tr.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Sağlığım, bir engelim veya yaşım yürümeyi zorlaştırıyor
tr.#I carry heavy things or accompany child: Ağır eşyalar taşıyorum veya çocuklara ya da başka kişilere eşlik ediyorum
tr.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Gerek duymuyorum: başka ulaşım yolları bana daha uygun

fa.#What keeps you from getting around on f: چه چیزی مانع می‌شود که پیاده جابه‌جا شوید یا این کار را بیشتر انجام دهید؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#We ask this to understand what limits w: این را می‌پرسیم تا بفهمیم چه چیزی پیاده‌روی را برای افراد مختلف محدود می‌کند. پاسخ دادن اختیاری است و می‌توانید ترجیح دهید آن را نگویید.
fa.#Steep slopes or stairs on the way: سربالایی‌های تند یا پله در مسیر
fa.#Sidewalks missing, too narrow or blocke: پیاده‌رو وجود ندارد، خیلی باریک است یا مسدود شده است
fa.#Poor lighting or not feeling safe from: روشنایی ضعیف یا احساس ناامنی در برابر افراد دیگر
fa.#My health, a disability or my age makes: وضعیت سلامتی، معلولیت یا سنم پیاده‌روی را دشوار می‌کند
fa.#I carry heavy things or accompany child: وسایل سنگین حمل می‌کنم یا کودکان یا افراد دیگر را همراهی می‌کنم
fa.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: نیازی ندارم: روش‌های دیگر جابه‌جایی برایم مناسب‌ترند

hu.#What keeps you from getting around on f: Mi akadályozza abban, hogy gyalog közlekedjen, vagy hogy gyakrabban tegye? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#We ask this to understand what limits w: Azért kérdezzük, hogy megértsük, mi korlátozza a gyaloglást a különböző emberek számára. A válaszadás nem kötelező, és azt is választhatja, hogy nem kívánja megadni.
hu.#Destinations are too far away: Az úti célok túl messze vannak
hu.#Steep slopes or stairs on the way: Meredek emelkedők vagy lépcsők az útvonalon
hu.#Sidewalks missing, too narrow or blocke: A járda hiányzik, túl keskeny vagy el van torlaszolva
hu.#Poor lighting or not feeling safe from: Gyenge közvilágítás, vagy hogy nem érzem magam biztonságban más emberektől
hu.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Az egészségi állapotom, egy fogyatékosság vagy a korom megnehezíti a gyaloglást
hu.#Heat or bad weather: A hőség vagy a rossz idő
hu.#I carry heavy things or accompany child: Nehéz dolgokat viszek, vagy gyerekeket, illetve másokat kísérek
hu.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Nincs rá szükségem: más közlekedési módok jobban megfelelnek nekem

ar.#What keeps you from getting around on f: ما الذي يمنعك من التنقّل سيرًا على الأقدام، أو من القيام بذلك أكثر؟ (اختر كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#We ask this to understand what limits w: نسأل عن ذلك لنفهم ما الذي يحدّ من المشي لدى أشخاص مختلفين. الإجابة اختيارية، ويمكنك أيضًا اختيار عدم الإفصاح.
ar.#Steep slopes or stairs on the way: منحدرات شديدة أو سلالم على الطريق
ar.#Sidewalks missing, too narrow or blocke: الأرصفة غير موجودة أو ضيقة جدًا أو مسدودة
ar.#Dangerous crossings or fast traffic: معابر خطرة أو حركة مرور سريعة
ar.#Poor lighting or not feeling safe from: إضاءة ضعيفة أو عدم الشعور بالأمان من الآخرين
ar.#My health, a disability or my age makes: صحتي أو إعاقة أو عمري يجعل المشي صعبًا
ar.#I carry heavy things or accompany child: أحمل أشياء ثقيلة أو أرافق أطفالًا أو أشخاصًا آخرين
ar.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: لا أحتاج إلى ذلك: وسائل تنقّل أخرى تناسبني أكثر
